name: lock-not-released
description: defer r.mu.Unlock() was replaced by an explicit Unlock at the end of the function, so the early return on an unknown team leaves the registry mutex held forever and every later Disable or read deadlocks. The window starts at the func declaration: a whole-function defect is honestly anchored there, and resource-leak lost a correct review to exactly that, one line above the first statement.

expected.why: The Unlock now runs only on the success path, so returning the unknown-team error leaves r.mu locked and every subsequent caller blocks forever.
